description: This file defines an abstract class for product plugins and functions to initialize and load remote product modules within a Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ProductPlugin
classes.description: An abstract class representing a product plugin with methods to initialize and uninitialize the plugin.

methods.name: initializeProducts
methods.description: Dispatches actions to load remote modules and configure the client, returning a promise.

methods.name: configureClient
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to a success data object, used to configure the client.

methods.name: loadRemoteModules
methods.description: Loads remote product modules asynchronously, initializing each product if found.

methods.name: initializeProduct
methods.description: Creates and initializes a product plugin instance with a registry and store.
